admissions.courseSummary: Patient managed with IV fluid rehydration, antiemetics, and electrolyte correction. Discharged stable.

days.doctorNote: Patient arrived with vomiting and loose stools. IV access established. IV fluids initiated. Electrolytes sent.
days.nurseNote: Vitals: BP 106/70, Pulse 98. Output 450ml in 6h. Infusion running smoothly.
days.proceduresDone: Peripheral IV Cannulation 20G left forearm, Intravenous Rehydration therapy, Stool analysis collection.

days.doctorNote: Vomiting subsided. Diarrhea controlled. Potassium normalized to 3.9 mEq/L. Shifted to oral fluids.
days.nurseNote: Vitals: BP 118/76, Pulse 82. Tolerating soft diet well. Ambulated comfortably.
days.proceduresDone: Electrolyte review, dietary advancement to oral fluids, discontinuation of IV fluids.

admissions.dischargeAdvice: Avoid outside food for 10 days. Continue boiled water. Resume routine Telmisartan.
